claims: Rick Pitino is the head men's basketball coach for the St. John's Red Storm.
Rick Pitino took over the St. John's program in 2023.
St. John's is a Big East school.
Rick Pitino won NCAA championships at Kentucky.
Rick Pitino won NCAA championships at Louisville.

Rick Pitino previously coached at Louisville.
Rick Pitino previously coached at Kentucky.

Rick Pitino previously coached at Boston University.
Rick Pitino previously coached for the New York Knicks.

Rick Pitino is the first coach to take three different schools to the Final Four.
